author: Google
description:
This is the story of Alphabet’s moonshot, Heritable Agriculture. At Heritable’s lab in the Bay Area, CEO Brad Zamft and his team are developing a platform that can predict which genetic combinations will thrive in specific climates and growing conditions, slashing breeding timelines from years to months.
